newsitem.title: USA: Orthologic gets FDA ok on bone-repair aid.
newsitem.headline: Orthologic gets FDA ok on bone-repair aid.

text.p: OrthoLogic Corp said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had approved the company's pre-market approval supplement for a single-coil model of the OrthoLogic 1000 bone growth stimulator.
With this FDA clearance, OrthoLogic can now market a single-coil model of the OL-1000 in addition to the original two-coil design.
The original design of the OL-1000 uses two coils to produce an electromagnetic field that stimulates healing of non-union fractures.
The OrthoLogic 1000 bone growth stimulator is prescribed by orthopaedic surgeons for noninvasive treatment of non-union bone fractures that are failing to reunite naturally.
